The following events took place in '''41 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*[[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] takes on [[Bant Eerin/Legends|Bant Eerin]] as his apprentice,<ref name="Jedi Apprentice Special Edition: The Followers">''[[Jedi Apprentice Special Edition: The Followers]]''</ref> following the death of the [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan's]] former master, [[Tahl]].<ref name="The Death of Hope">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Death of Hope]]''</ref>
*[[Sheeka Tull]] and [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] meet in the [[Meridian sector/Legends|Meridian sector]].<ref name="The Cestus Deception">''[[The Cestus Deception]]''</ref>
*[[Vaykaaris Uprising]] takes place. {{Circa}}<ref name="CSWE" />
